title: The water programme reports a substantially lower cost per beneficiary
statement: The water programme reaches a beneficiary at roughly a fifth of the nutrition programme’s reported cost for the same reporting period.
implication: Marginal funding directed to the water programme would reach more beneficiaries at the same spend, on the reported figures alone.
audience_relevance: An institutional funder comparing cost-effectiveness across programmes weighs this figure directly.

title: The water programme has unused delivery capacity
statement: The water programme has unused staffing capacity that would allow it to scale without new hiring.
implication: Scaling the water programme would not require the lead time or cost of building new operational capacity first.
audience_relevance: The programme director weighing what can realistically scale this cycle weighs this directly.
